answer_2.quote: To evaluate phrase informativeness and diversity, we use tf-idf and word diversity (worddiv.) to evaluate the top topical phrases.

answer_4.quote: We asked 4 annotators to answer these questions and each annotator answers 150 questions on average.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are asked to select the intruder phrase. We can see that UCTOPIC, PNTM and TopMine can recognize similar numbers of coherent topics, but the numbers of Phrase-LDA are less than the other three models. For a coherent topic, each of the top phrases will be labeled as correct if the phrase reflects the related topic.
